## Five papers that show what I do

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card style="border:none;"}
::: {.pc-body}
::: {.pc-meta}
Applied risk assessment
:::
### Vessel risk to seabirds in the North Pacific and Arctic
Where do ships and seabirds overlap, and when? A multi-scale seasonal risk
analysis built to be used directly in spatial planning and spill response.

*Kapsar, Sullender & Kuletz (2025), Conservation Biology*

::: {.pc-links}
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1111/cobi.70115)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-card style="border:none;"}
::: {.pc-body}
::: {.pc-meta}
Data infrastructure
:::
### Multi-scale environmental geodiversity for NEON
Continental-scale environmental heterogeneity layers plus a reusable workflow —
an example of the kind of durable data product I build.

*Kapsar et al. (2026), Scientific Data*

::: {.pc-links}
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-026-07613-5)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-card style="border:none;"}
::: {.pc-body}
::: {.pc-meta}
Does policy work?
:::
### Effectiveness of IMO "Areas to be Avoided" in the Bering Strait
An empirical test of whether a management designation actually changed vessel
behavior on the water.

*Block, Remer, Kapsar & Schmidt (2025), Marine Policy*

::: {.pc-links}
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marpol.2025.106849)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-card style="border:none;"}
::: {.pc-body}
::: {.pc-meta}
Macroecology at scale
:::
### Environmental variability shapes life history of the world's birds
A global analysis linking 70+ years of climate variability to avian generation
length across species ranges.

*Youngflesh, Kapsar et al. (2024), Ecology Letters*

::: {.pc-links}
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1111/ele.70077)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-card style="border:none;"}
::: {.pc-body}
::: {.pc-meta}
Climate & the Arctic
:::
### Vessel traffic in the ice-covered waters of the Pacific Arctic
Combining sea ice remote sensing with AIS to quantify how ice loss is opening
the Arctic to shipping.

*Kapsar, Gunn, Brigham & Liu (2023), Climatic Change*

::: {.pc-links}
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10584-023-03568-3)
:::
:::
:::
